# Project Phoenix

Project Phoenix is a local, deterministic agent portfolio for evaluating
domain-specific analytical workflows, routing surfaces, and model interfaces.

The core design rule is that authoritative answers come from grounded
substrates: databases, files, schemas, solvers, and validation artifacts.
Language models are optional interface layers for routing, formatting, and
bounded generation; they are not the source of truth.

## Current Focus

- OpenClaw/Phoenix operator shell and incident workflow.
- ShowcaseAgent deterministic domain routing.
- PPR Agent medical-device Product Performance Report substrate.
- Literal-substrate experiments for model/harness boundary analysis.

```bash
uv run pytest -q
scripts/check_openclaw_hardening.sh --skip-live
scripts/openclaw_showcase_routing_demo.sh --human
python domains/DemoAgents/PPR_Agent/test_agent.py
```

Live OpenClaw endpoint checks require the gateway to be running on
`127.0.0.1:19001`.
